title: Why are we all so stressed?

vocabulary.meaning: a state of mental or emotional pressure caused by difficult situations
examples: Work stress can affect sleep and health.
Many people experience stress during busy periods.

vocabulary.meaning: a feeling of worry caused by demands or expectations
examples: She felt pressure to finish the project quickly.
Financial pressure can affect family relationships.

vocabulary.meaning: physical and emotional exhaustion caused by long-term stress or overwork
examples: Long working hours can lead to burnout.
He took time off after experiencing burnout.

vocabulary.meaning: the amount of work a person has to do
examples: A heavy workload can increase stress.
The manager redistributed the workload among the team.

vocabulary.meaning: a feeling of worry, nervousness, or fear
examples: Constant stress can contribute to anxiety.
Exercise helps some people manage anxiety.

vocabulary.meaning: to deal successfully with a difficult situation
examples: People use different methods to cope with stress.
She found it difficult to cope with the pressure.
